title: Missouri congressional-map TRO expiry — the 14-day term Judge Clark wrote into the order compelling the 2025 map
source: NEWS: THE DATE IS NO LONGER COMPUTED — it is now read off the court's own order. Onder v. State of Missouri, No. 4:26-cv-01424-SRC (E.D. Mo.), doc. 35, 'Memorandum and Order' signed by Chief District Judge Stephen R. Clark on 2026-09-08, obtained direct 2026-09-09 from the CourtListener RECAP archive (storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.moed.231153/gov.uscourts.moed.231153.35.0_1.pdf, HTTP 200, 320,306 bytes, PDF text layer decompressed locally; 13 of 13 pages recovered) and cross-read against the docket text served by the CourtListener v4 search API for the same document. The operative sentence is the court's own: 'This order remains in effect for 14 days from the date of issuance. The Court will set a preliminary injunction hearing by separate order.' Issuance 2026-09-08 + 14 days = 2026-09-22 (a Tuesday). This SUPERSEDES the derivation the proposing lane filed, which read the 14 days out of press reports and computed the date from Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(b)(2)'s ceiling; the rule turns out not to be the operative mechanism at all, because doc. 35 records that the TRO issued WITH notice and full adversarial briefing — 'All parties, including Intervenors People Not Politicians and Richard von Glahn, had notice and submitted briefing' and 'the Court finds that a hearing is not necessary because all parties have participated fully through their briefing' — while Rule 65(b)(2)'s 14-day cap governs orders issued without notice. The 14 days here is the court's discretionary term, which happens to match the rule's ceiling. STATUS STAYS ESTIMATE on the same mechanical count the sibling ledgers missouri-map-ballot-deadline-2026-09-08, missouri-uocava-ballot-mailing-2026-09-19 and midterm-elections-2026-11-03 each recorded: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for a court order, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Understating the label only widens caution. Press corroboration read direct 2026-09-09: Roll Call 2026-09-08 ('the order will remain in effect for 14 days, pending a hearing on a more permanent order'). Blocked this session and not relied on: courtlistener.com HTML search (403), dockets.justia.com (403), the CourtListener docket-entries REST endpoint (401, token-gated)
notes: Proposed by the missouri-map-ballot-deadline-2026-09-08 close-out (2026-09-09) as the next dated point in a fight that did NOT end on 09-08; canonical file written 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research, which read the underlying order rather than reports of it. THE CENTRAL FINDING IS THAT THIS DATE IS A CEILING ON A PLACEHOLDER, NOT A RESOLUTION POINT. Three mechanisms all land before it and any one moots it: (1) People Not Politicians / von Glahn filed an emergency notice of appeal the same evening (doc. 36) and an emergency motion to stay pending appeal (doc. 38), docketed in the Eighth Circuit as Congressman Robert Onder v. Richard von Glahn, No. 26-2797, 2026-09-08 19:25 CT, with the emergency stay motion filed 19:55 CT; (2) the district court said it will set a preliminary-injunction hearing 'by separate order', and a PI granted before 09-22 replaces the TRO rather than letting it expire; (3) the UOCAVA transmission date 2026-09-19 (missouri-uocava-ballot-mailing-2026-09-19) sits THREE DAYS EARLIER and is the operational forcing function — ballots go out under whichever map is operative then. As of the CourtListener snapshot timestamped 2026-09-09T00:29Z the newest district entry is doc. 38 and no PI hearing date had been set. MERITS, from doc. 35 read direct: likelihood of success found on the Equal Protection claim ('Replacing the HB 1 map after the primary would sort hundreds of thousands of voters into different districts'), with Article I, Section 2 supported by United States v. Classic, 313 U.S. 299, 318 (1941), and an express 'Purcell in reverse' holding — 'Issuing a TRO here would preserve, rather than disturb, the election rules that candidates, election officials, and voters have relied on.' Imminence is pinned to Mo. Rev. Stat. § 115.125(2), the same 09-08 ballot-finalization deadline the sibling event tracks. NOTABLE GAP: doc. 13 ordered every party to brief federal abstention and Rooker-Feldman by noon 09-07, and no abstention or Rooker-Feldman analysis appears anywhere in the 13 pages of doc. 35 recovered this session. Not a market event: symbols: [], and the tape across the two-court clash was VIX 14.53 (09-04) to 15.72 (09-08) and S&P 7718.60 to 7673.52 (-0.58%), with 09-08's named drivers being the 3-year note auction and pre-CPI positioning. Its plus-or-minus-5-day corridor holds 29 tracked events including opex 09-18, the BoJ decision 09-18 and the Trump-Xi summit 09-24, so the date is structurally unobservable. Tracked as a seat-math input to midterm-elections-2026-11-03 and as a companion to missouri-uocava-ballot-mailing-2026-09-19. If a scheduling order later names the PI hearing date, that date — not this one — is the event worth tracking, and this entry should be re-dated or retired rather than defended.
